name: dashboard
description: Open the terminal Dashboard when attaching to a Booley Sandbox (and again with the Booley: Open Dashboard command), close the unused Chat side bar once, reopen Codespaces startup files with their associated editor, and host the Viewer Bridge that `bwave gui` uses to show scoped waveform views.

booley.dashboard.attachProtocol.description: Booley-generated Sandbox attach protocol. Zero disables automatic opening.
